column2: Each province has its own economy: GDP per person in Nuevo León is more than three times that of Chiapas, even though both are in the same country. That is why where you live, invest or open a business changes the outcome.

Tap any province or city on the map: the bubble shows the essentials and the buttons to act from there. «📋 Profile» opens everything: province, country and cities. «ⓘ Explain» adds what each figure means.

Tap the map: tapping a province shows a bubble with its population, its GDP per person and its happiness, plus the buttons to act from there (move, invest, open a business, build, move your army or do diplomacy, depending on your situation). If you tap a city name, the bubble is for that city.
  • 📋 Profile: tabs Province (data, resources, buildings, your interests and every action), Country (government, economy, its stock exchange and its league) and Cities (inhabitants and clubs).
  • ⓘ Explain: adds below the figures what each one means in the real world and in the game. It stays on until you turn it off.
  • ✏️: in the profile of a country, a club, a listed company or your company you can rename it right there.
  • Auto-advance: while it runs, a bar shows how much is left until the month closes and what comes next (fight, final, review, a conversation about to expire, elections or New Year). Tap it to pause.
  • 👥 next to the clock: the colored dot sums up your social life (green good, amber stable, red strained). Tap it to see your pending conversations.
